scientific_integrity: A fully quantified exact theorem restricted to the two reflection-axis direction orbits, with analytic proof and finite corroborating checker. No assertion of unrestricted directional optimality or independent verification.
scientific_limitations: Only mirror-axis normals to the circumradius-one regular octagon are compared; other normals may outperform both.
Identical optimality over translations is claimed only as attainment by a centered plank, not uniqueness.
Independent mathematical audit and complete historical priority assessment are outstanding.
title: Three symmetry-axis preference reversals for partial planks of a regular octagon
